examples.title: Confirmation
examples.description: Short-lived acknowledgement after a completed action.
examples.behavior: Summarize the result and provide one reversible action when useful.
examples.qa: Toast copy is concise and does not require reading the page behind it.

examples.title: Failure
examples.behavior: Name what failed and offer the next action.
examples.qa: Error tone is visible while the retry action remains reachable.

examples.title: Working
examples.description: Temporary feedback while a background action continues.
examples.behavior: Avoid using loading toasts for long-running tasks that need progress detail.
examples.qa: Loading state cannot be mistaken for success.

loading.qa: User can still understand current status.

mobile.qa: Actions wrap below copy if needed.
